pilot: first 5 pilot_tasks from existing frozen R4 split, both baseline/rules, repeat 0
prior_exposure: Existing public 115 tasks/53 customers; new inference contexts only. No independent human validation or cross-provider claim.
training: No fitting, selection, prompt changes, or calibration from pilot results. Any later training uses inherited train partition; inherited test remains separate by customer as original split records.
stop: Three consecutive model calls without a result stop collection; no account rotation or quota circumvention.
score: Existing isolated gold sandbox state/output scoring; model sees policy/tools/history only.
live_cover: Not implemented; no replay is described as replanning.
